title: Quarterly segmented cohort lanes roadmap for enterprise isolated onboarding
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a repeatable quarterly roadmap and checklist for onboarding enterprise customers to isolated Private/VPC/on‑prem deployments using segmented cohort lanes. This ticket defines the lanes, success metrics, gating criteria, and orchestration plan for Q1 with the goal of reducing time-to-live for a new customer from contract to production by 40% while meeting SLAs and compliance requirements.
scope: Define 3 onboarding lanes (pilot, expansion, and enterprise-scale); produce lane-specific runbooks, compatibility matrix, upgrade window templates, and cost/SLA bundles; coordinate gating with infra, security, and solutions engineering; produce OKR mappings and acceptance criteria for release.
goals: Standardize onboarding across cohort lanes so each new customer is placed in an appropriate lane within 72h of contract signature.
Reduce manual checks by 60% via templates and automated compatibility checks.
Map each lane to explicit OKR milestones and acceptance criteria tied to time-to-live, availability, and data isolation audit logs.
Establish rollback and fast-fail triggers to protect production SLAs during staged rollouts.
success_metrics: Median time-to-production for cohort lanes (target: pilot 7d, expansion 21d, enterprise-scale 45d)
Number of post-onboarding incidents within 30d (target: <=1 per 10 onboardings)
Customer satisfaction (NPS) for onboarding (target: +20 improved from baseline)
milestones: M1: Lane definitions and compatibility matrix finalized (2025-01-24)
M2: Runbooks and checklist templates available in Confluence (2025-02-07)
M3: Automated preflight checks and cost estimate generator in staging (2025-02-21)
M4: Pilot cohort launch and telemetry dashboard (2025-03-07)
M5: Formal OKR sign-off and go/no-go for enterprise lane (2025-03-21)
acceptance_criteria: All lane runbooks exist and are reviewed by Solutions Eng, Security, and SRE
Automated preflight checks run successfully against 3 representative onprem templates
Cost/SLA bundle generator returns repeatable estimates within 10% of manual pricing
Telemetry dashboard surfaces lane-level health and onboarding progress with <5m latency
Stakeholders (Sales lead, Customer Success, Legal) have approved gating criteria
updates: 2025-01-12: Kickoff with Solutions Eng and SRE; agreed to keep three lanes to reduce complexity.
2025-01-18: Trade-off discussion — full automation for enterprise lane deferred due to compliance variance; decided to implement semi-automated approvals and templated configs.
2025-01-24: Compatibility matrix draft complete; found two common network config variants requiring custom scripts (ENG-11805 opened).
2025-01-30: Design feedback from DES-221 on runbook UX; simplified checklist and added explicit rollback steps.
2025-02-05: Security review scoping meeting; determined HSM/KMS key rotation must be part of enterprise lane checklist (security_review_required=true).
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Customer network topologies vary widely and can block automated preflight checks. Mitigation: maintain a 'network exception' pattern and schedule early network discovery call during sales handoff.
Risk: Upgrade windows conflict with customer maintenance windows. Mitigation: build a shared calendar template and require maintenance windows during contract negotiation.
Risk: SRE capacity during simultaneous cohort launches. Mitigation: cap concurrent enterprise lane onboarding and enable auto-escalation rules to Dedicated pool (ENG-11422).
next_steps: Assign owners for each runbook section (Solutions Eng, Security, SRE) by 2025-01-15
Begin implementation of preflight checks (ENG sprint 2025-W03)
Create Confluence space with lane templates and link to cost estimator PR
Schedule pilot cohort customers and confirm telemetry events with Observability team
